arguments.sql:
WITH ncs_payments AS (
  SELECT payment_id, nsw_ref, SUM(amount_ngn_minor) AS ncs_paid_minor
  FROM v_collections
  WHERE entity_id = 'NCS'
    AND paid_day = '2026-10-04'
  GROUP BY payment_id, nsw_ref
), ranked AS (
  SELECT payment_id, nsw_ref, ncs_paid_minor
  FROM ncs_payments
  ORDER BY ncs_paid_minor DESC
  LIMIT 1
), cons_total AS (
  SELECT c.nsw_ref, SUM(c.amount_ngn_minor) AS consignment_total_paid_minor
  FROM v_collections c
  JOIN ranked r ON c.nsw_ref = r.nsw_ref
  GROUP BY c.nsw_ref
)

FROM ranked r
JOIN cons_total ct ON ct.nsw_ref = r.nsw_ref;
